annotations.title: Estimate what a Bulgarian property would sell or rent for

description: An estimate of what a property in an oblast capital (София, Пловдив, Варна, Бургас, …) or one of its квартали would ask on sale and on rent: the median asking price per m² of Realistimo's live listings there — the figures of its price statistics pages — times the area. With askingPrice it also says where that price sits among the listings' prices per m² (below the cheapest 10%, under or over the median, above the dearest 10%). Use for „колко струва апартаментът ми", „колко наем да искам", „скъпа ли е тази обява". Not an appraisal.

areaSqm.description: Floor area in m² (plot area for a plot).

askingPrice.description: A price in euros to check against the listings.

language.description: Language of the answer's labels and of the realistimo.com link: bg, en, tr, de, ru, ro, el or uk. Default bg.

location.description: A place in Bulgaria — city, квартал (neighbourhood) or village — in Bulgarian or Latin letters, e.g. "София", "Лозенец, София", "Varna".

rooms.description: Rooms, for APARTMENT, HOUSE or FLOOR_HOUSE; four or more are one group, as on the statistics pages.

name: realistimo_estimate_price

figuresFor.description: The place the figures describe — the квартал, or its city when the квартал has none of its own.

notes.description: How to read the figures; repeat the relevant ones to the user.

url.description: The realistimo.com page this answer comes from.

title: Estimate what a Bulgarian property would sell or rent for
